title: NODEZ nearing release state, seeking bored testers!
author: Necessary-Court2738
selftext:
NODEZ is nearing release state and I could use YOUR help!

Are you BORED?

Do you like CITY BUILDERS?

Charming ASCII graphics?

Petting dogs??

Then try out NODEZ for free today! I’ve added so many new features and my own polish that I’m getting overwhelmed testing everything!

5 save slots, achievements that add buffs, smoother gameplay, and much more!

Now mobile friendly!

\*Developed with Claude workflow vibe coding. I initially came up with this game on scratch paper, then decided I wanted to see what I could do with that vision! Claude encoded the music and game data, I made the title sound with my own wet vocal cords! Everything else was a mix of prompting, testing, and tweaking.

Have fun and let me know what you think :)

https://zellybeanwizard.itch.io/nodez

comments.author: Revelation12Studios
comments.body:
Catchy music. 🎶  

Did you hire someone to make it?

replies.author: Necessary-Court2738
replies.body: Nope! I’ll have to go find the original prompt, but I generated it and then edited it in audacity/ compressed it into base64 encoding :)

replies.author: Ok_Mechanic806
replies.body: Why did you edit and compress it? Did you pay for licensing and distribution rights? How was it made? (What generation tool)

replies.author: Necessary-Court2738
replies.body: It was made on Beatoven Ai, then compressed into mp3 because a .wav base64 string is… really really long. I then had Claude convert to base64!

replies.author: Necessary-Court2738
replies.body: I found the prompt!  “Chipper chiptune loop built for an endless level-select screen: bright 8-bit square leads over a pulsing sidechain-style bass, playful triangle arps ping-ponging left-right, and cheerful 8-bit brass and xylophone call-and-response. Energy stays medium-up with gentle syncopation, tight 4-bar phrases designed to loop seamlessly; occasional filtered breaks and octave jumps keep it fresh while staying focus-friendly and non-intrusive., bright, world, playful, bassline, gentle, loving, happy”

replies.author: Necessary-Court2738
replies.body: And to clarify yes I have the certificate! I’m adding more tracks as well as working on some long term secret updates! Stay tuned~

comments.author: Capable-Wonder3583
comments.body:
Man you crushed it!  
The tutorial is great and the music xd  
played one round and lost fast the game takes time to understand but thats whats fun about it.  
I love the art style, it's so clean and minimal but capturing. I love it I think it's beautiful and perfect because it doesnt hurt gameplay at all and I think it supports and improves it. I'll continue playing and update.

replies.author: Necessary-Court2738
replies.body: Thank you! I am working on patches right now so it will be coming up and down until tonight. I’m adding more music tracks!

replies.author: Capable-Wonder3583
replies.body: I found some bugs if you want me to report somehow

replies.author: Necessary-Court2738
replies.body: Sure! You can DM any details you find, I typically work on bugs same day :)
